description: AI Super Inbox lets users search and review stored incoming and outgoing messages from the WhatsApp account they authorize. Filter messages by date or contact, open individual messages, and inspect available image attachments. Results may include sender and recipient identifiers, message text, timestamps, delivery status, and image contents. Summarize conversations and review customer payment claims for reconciliation; replies and screenshots do not verify bank receipt. Access is read-only and tied to the individual user's permissions. The connector cannot send messages, update payment records, or access bank transactions. Image retrieval supports available WhatsApp-hosted PNG, JPEG, and WebP attachments up to 8 MB; expired attachments and images stored only as external URLs cannot be retrieved. AI Super Inbox is an independent product of AI Super Private Limited, not affiliated with or endorsed by OpenAI or Meta. WhatsApp is mentioned only to identify the supported messaging service.

defaultPrompt: Summarize today’s incoming and outgoing WhatsApp messages using Singapore time.
Find PayNow messages and payment screenshots. Flag claims that need bank verification.
Review recent WhatsApp conversations and identify questions that appear unanswered.
